Definition: from G5142; a nourisher, i.e. nurse:--nurse.
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is trophós, meaning a nourisher, i.e. nurse. It appears once, in 1 Thessalonians 2:7.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: trophós matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
